Proverbs applies it to wisdom: 'Blessed is the one who finds wisdom' (Prov 3:13). The German 'selig' and French 'heureux' each capture a slightly different facet — blessedness and happiness — while Spanish 'bienaventurado' fuses both ideas into one word."
